package.name: CAD X-ray
package.description: MCP server that lets Claude Code diagnose and edit the open FreeCAD document: document graph, sketch constraint diagnostics and fix proposals, shape validity, holes, interference, STEP/STL rebuild into parametric features, TechDraw pages. Runs a localhost-only XML-RPC listener (127.0.0.1:9877) inside FreeCAD; nothing leaves the machine. Needs the companion bridge (uv/mcp) registered in Claude Code — see README.

workbench.name: CAD X-ray
workbench.description: Diagnostic MCP server for Claude Code (localhost 127.0.0.1:9877)
